opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)

amount.raw: Grants under £100,000; typically 10-20% of an organisation's total annual budget; local community capital projects up to £30,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs), and organisations exempt/excepted under Charity Commission guidance; must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts (independently audited or examined, or a Charity Commission annual return); must work inside the UK or UK Overseas Territories; cannot be individuals, CICs, community benefit societies, social enterprises, or local authorities.
opportunities.summary: Rolling grant programme open all year round with no submission deadlines. Supports operating/core costs, capital projects, and projects/specific activities across arts, community, education, environment, faith, health, museums and heritage, welfare and youth. Applications reviewed in order received with decisions within 4-6 months.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Organisations must be UK registered charities, CIOs or exempt/excepted. For capital or project costs, the total project cost must be at least £1 million regardless of annual income. For core costs, the organisation's annual income must be at least £1 million.
opportunities.summary: Rolling major grant programme for grants of £100,000 and over. Expressions of Interest accepted all year round with no deadlines, reviewed on a rolling basis, and considered by Trustees at one of eight Board meetings per year. Supports operating/core costs, capital projects, and projects/specific activities.
